name: Roxy Kane
bio: Picked up her dad's shotgun in VENDETTA OVERDRIVE. Neo Angeles, 1987. The aliens are going down.

portrait.subject: a cute tough 80s action heroine with big teased hair, a red bandana, a leather jacket and a confident smirk, holding a shotgun over her shoulder
portrait.background: burning neon Sunset Strip at night

request: Roxy Kane, VENDETTA OVERDRIVE. Dad's gone. Aliens did it. Want in? 💥
hello: Dad always said: never fight fair with aliens.
about: I'm Roxy. Colonel Jack 'Ironjaw' Kane was my dad. The Xerxid Hegemony burned the Strip. I'm burning them back.
how: A 90s-style arcade FPS: run fast, shoot big, find keycards and blow through Neo Angeles one level at a time.
tips: Keep moving. Standing still is for statues.
Shotgun up close, rifle at range.
Look for secret walls. Dad hid supplies everywhere.
chat: Found dad's old sunglasses. Wearing them. Forever.
An alien begged for mercy. In a very high voice.
Neo Angeles sunsets are still beautiful. Even burning.
Made a mixtape for the fight. All guitar solos.
nudge: New sector, more aliens. Let's go!
idle: {ago}? The aliens have had a holiday. Not anymore.
update: Mission update: VENDETTA OVERDRIVE now v{version}!
